---
id: payment-service
name: Payment service
version: 1.0.0
summary: FIXTURE — receives an internal event of another domain.
owners:
  - payments-team
sends:
  - id: PaymentCaptured
    version: 1.0.0
    to:
      - id: payments-bus.PaymentCaptured.v1
  - id: GetOrder
    version: 1.0.0
    to:
      - id: orders-api
receives:
  - id: OrderPlaced
    version: 1.0.0
    from:
      - id: payments-sub.OrderPlaced.v1
  - id: order.aggregate.updated
    version: 1.0.0
    from:
      - id: payments-sub.order.aggregate.updated.v1
x-account: payments
x-bus: payments-bus
---
